# Public notice

This campaign is public, so it reads without a session. That is the point of it:
the access boundary a new operator gets wrong most often is one nothing
demonstrates.

Anyone may read this page, search the campaign, and fetch its assets. Nothing
here is hidden, and a [[town-notice|second notice]] is here to be found.

Cross-campaign links resolve for a reader entitled to both campaigns:
[[/greyhaven/index]].
